verdict.rationale: The GST help modules document a sanctioned third-party representative rail: a GST Practitioner enrols on the portal and accepts or rejects a taxpayer's request to act on their behalf. The evidence is only a one-line module description, so the scope of what a practitioner may do and how the taxpayer authorizes, limits, or revokes them is not shown. Missing for 10: details of the practitioner's permitted actions and authorization/revocation flow, evidence of other sanctioned provider rails (e.g., authorized API/service providers via the developer portal), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
